name: prizm-checker
description: Audit a repo for alignment with the PRIZM design system and produce a diagnostic report with a % alignment score across five axes: tokens (A1), component adoption (A2), fidelity (A3), composition (A4), and accessibility (A5). Source passes, including WCAG AA contrast on resolvable colour pairs (PRIZM policy); an optional rendered axe-core pass gives full WCAG (inherited contrast, roles, focus). Covers React/Next web products and JavaFX thick clients.
